description: A strip marker removes the figure space U+2007
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The figure space U+2007 is a space separator (category Zs) with the White_Space property, but not in Pattern_White_Space, the set Unicode recommends for syntax (UAX #31), and some libraries, such as Java's Character.isWhitespace, leave it out as a no-break space. Stripping it is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
